verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents private API keys with API key scopes for all /api endpoints. It says scopes limit what third parties can access, and a 'Custom' access level lets the owner decide how much access to grant, so a restricted key for a contractor or agent is clearly supported. OAuth is also offered for app integrations. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a read-only key option or a per-resource scope list showing analytics/reporting read access separable from campaign create/send, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
